description: 藍色短鮑頭、紅眼嘅 chibi 零波，著住白色插入栓服配橙色滾邊。會呼吸眨眼、左右跑步、揮手、跳、失望流淚、耐心等待、專心做嘢，同埋 16 個方向嘅視線。

reference.prompt:
An original chibi anime mascot character design, full body, front view, centered on the canvas, standing upright on both feet with both arms relaxed at her sides, calm neutral expression, looking straight at the viewer.

Character design:
- Chibi anime mascot style, about two heads tall with an oversized round head and a tiny slim body.
- Short steel-blue bob-cut hair with straight blunt bangs, the hair cut just above the shoulders, two short side locks framing the face, soft blue cel shading.
- Big red eyes with white highlights, tiny nose, small neutral mouth, faint blush on the cheeks.
- A white form-fitting EV-style plugsuit: high black-trimmed collar, orange accent trim at the hip and the thighs, a few black strap details, pale purple-navy panel accents on the sides, dark grey boots. Clean and modest, the suit reads as a sci-fi pilot suit.
- Warm dark-brown outline, flat cel-shaded pastel anime-mascot art style, clean flat vector look, crisp outlines, smooth cel shading.
- No readable logos, no lettering, no text anywhere.

Background: plain seamless pure white background, even soft studio lighting, no ground shadow, no floor, no props, no text, no watermark, no border.

prompts.character: Picture 1 is the exact character to reproduce in every panel: same chibi proportions (about two heads tall, oversized round head, tiny slim body), same steel-blue bob-cut hair with straight blunt bangs and two short side locks framing the face, same big red eyes with white highlights, same faint blush, same white EV plugsuit with the high black-trimmed collar, orange accent trim at the hip and thighs, black strap details, pale purple-navy side panels and dark grey boots, same warm dark-brown outline, same flat cel-shaded pastel anime-mascot art style, same size in every panel.
prompts.ground: In every panel the character stands on the same horizontal ground line near the bottom of its own panel, fully visible with clear white margin around it, identical camera angle and identical lighting.
prompts.background: Background: plain seamless pure white in every panel. No grid lines, no borders, no frames, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no ground shadow, no floor, no props, no extra characters.

run-right.note: While running: she leans slightly forward, her blue bob hair and side locks stream backward, her eyes look forward in the direction of travel, and her arms swing. The whole figure stays compact and upright: the total width of the character is only slightly wider than she is tall, never stretched out. The eight panels must read as one smooth looping run cycle.

jump.note: She keeps exactly the same body size in all five panels; only her pose and her height inside the panel change. Panel 1 and panel 5 are on the ground line, panels 2 to 4 are in the air at different heights, panel 3 being the highest.
